content.title: About
content.content: American cheese is a processed cheese made from a blend of cheeses (usually cheddar), milk, cream, salt and food additives. It has a smooth, uniform texture, a mild buttery flavor and a characteristic bright yellow color. It is widely used in restaurants and fast‑food, especially in burgers and sandwiches.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: American cheese was developed in the early 1900s in the USA as a way to extend cheese shelf life.
It often contains emulsifiers that allow the cheese to melt evenly without separating fat.
Originally sold in sheets, later it became available in pre‑sliced portions.
In Russia the cheese is commonly referred to as “burger cheese”.
Low‑sodium and dye‑free versions are now available.

items.title: Calcium source
items.content: Provides calcium essential for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Delivers complete protein important for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Contains vitamin B12 and riboflavin, supporting nervous system function and red blood cell formation.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: The processed texture makes it gentle on the digestive system, especially for children and the elderly.

items.title: Energy dense
items.content: Provides quick energy through its fat and carbohydrate content.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: The amount of salt may be unsuitable for people with hypertension.

items.title: Food additives
items.content: Emulsifiers and preservatives can cause allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Saturated fats
items.content: Contains saturated fats, which should be limited in heart‑related conditions.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Contains lactose, making it unsuitable for those who are lactose intolerant.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: American cheese is commonly used in hot sandwiches, burgers, macaroni and cheese, casseroles and sauces. It can be sliced, melted in a microwave or skillet, and added to salads for a mild cheesy note.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the original packaging or an airtight container in the refrigerator at 1 °C–4 °C. The shelf life is indicated on the package, generally up to 3‑4 weeks. Discard if any mold, off‑odor, or discoloration appears.
